items.mnemonic_text: A single horizontal stroke is the ground floor: one.
Two stacked strokes count out two.
Three stacked strokes: one, two, three.
A mouth boxing in legs that kick four ways: four.
A shape crossing itself, the hand held up: five fingers.
A little hat on two legs stands over six.
A slanted cross like a scythe cutting seven.
Two strokes spreading apart like the number eight opening up.
A hook curling back at the top of the count: nine.
A perfect plus sign, fingers of both hands: ten.
One (一) over a white (白) sheet counted a hundred times.
A slash over ten (十) multiplies it into a thousand.
A single hooked mark standing for a whole ten thousand.
A boxed shape holding the round yen coin.
A window with a line: the sun rising to mark the day.
A crescent with two lines: the moon marking each month.
A person with sparks flying off each side: fire.
Streams splashing out from a central flow: water.
A trunk with roots and branches: a tree.
A roof over a mountain of buried gold and money.
A cross pushed into the ground: earth and soil.
Three peaks rising up: a mountain range.
Three flowing lines of a running river.
A person (大) with a line above their head: the heavens.
Steam rising with an X inside: the invisible energy or mood.
Grass on top of a person changing (化): a blooming flower.
A mark sitting on top of a line: up and above.
A mark hanging under a line: down and below.
A box speared straight through the middle.
A person stretching arms and legs out wide: big.
A tiny hook with two small dots: small.
A hand over a craftsman's tool, held in the left hand.
A hand over a mouth, the right hand that feeds you.
The sun (日) tangled in a tree (木): sunrise in the east.
A bird settling into its nest as the sun sets in the west.
A warm shelter facing the sunny south.
Two people back to back turning away from the cold north.
Evening (夕) plus divination: reading fortunes outside.
A blade cutting the way forward, in front of you.
A small step trailing behind: after and behind.
A marker at the top of the day: noon.
A tree (木) with a line marking its root: the origin, a book.
Two legs walking: a person.
A figure kneeling gracefully: a woman.
Power (力) worked in the rice field (田): a working man.
A swaddled baby with arms out: a child.
An upright frame with pupils inside: an eye.
A dangling shape on the side of the head: an ear.
An open square: a mouth.
Fingers and a wrist branching out: a hand.
A mouth over stopping legs: a foot that carries you.
A flexed arm pushing: power and strength.
A sprout pushing up from the ground: life and birth.
In the evening (夕) you call out a mouth's (口) name.
A person carrying grain across one full year.
The sun (日) at the temple (寺) marks the hour.
The sun (日) seen through a gate (門): the space in between.
The sun (日) with wings and birds: naming each day of the week.
A roof over a moment held in the hand: now.
Making a lap around the calendar road: one week.
A person over a mother figure repeating every time.
A shape split evenly down the middle: half.
A sword (刀) dividing something into parts and minutes.
A child (子) under a roof of scattered ideas: study.
A tree (木) crossed with mingling students: a school.
A person stepping ahead of the rest: previous and first.
Speech (言) with a mouth counting to five (五): words and language.
Speech (言) plus a tongue (舌): telling a story.
Words (言) sold (売) to your eyes: reading.
A brush (聿) laid over a sunny page: writing.
An ear (耳) inside the gate (門): listening for who is there.
A crossroads where you choose to go.
A tree of grain drawing people to come.
A broom and a stop: sweeping up and returning home.
Two mountains stacked, something pushing out.
A person ducking under a doorway to enter.
An eye (目) on legs going out to see.
A foot planted firmly: stop.
A person standing on the ground line: to stand.
Two people (人) sitting on the earth (土) under a roof.
A person (人) leaning on a tree (木): resting.
A mouth releasing lines of speech: to say.
A net (罒) over money (貝): buying with cash.
Goods laid out on a stand: selling.
A roof over a heap of good rice: food to eat.
Food (食) beside a person yawning (欠) for a drink.
A ray of sunlight so bright it turns white.
The earth glowing under a big fire: red.
A fresh sprout over the moon: the blue-green of youth.
A sooty village over a fire: black with smoke.
A tall tower with windows: high and expensive.
A woman (女) safe under a roof: peaceful and cheap.
A standing tree cut by an axe (斤): freshly new.
Ten (十) mouths (口) of stories passed down: old.
Two evenings (夕) stacked: many days piling up.
Small (小) with a slash taken off: even fewer.
Flowing long hair on an elder: long and the eldest.
The sun (日) already up over the ground (十): early.
A jewel (玉) enclosed by borders: a country.
Drops falling inside a window frame from the sky: rain.
Rain (雨) with lightning stretching down: electricity.
A cart seen from above with an axle: a vehicle.
A horse (馬) waiting where trains stop: a station.
A neck (首) moving down a path: the road and the way.
A rice field (田) marked out into a town.
A cloth over a stand where the city market gathers.
